verdict.rationale: Archived docs once described a REST interface for connecting to MCP servers. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the "Smithery API, Connect, and Toolbox" and "Smithery accounts and API keys" stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that there is no longer a documented API surface. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all return 404. The surviving CLI is a command-line tool, not a documented public API, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
